shots.title: Slow walk on the lawn
shots.notes: Calm opening: Mira takes slow steps across the lawn while Mango sniffs the flowers, then moves past the flowerbeds.

shots.title: Running fast
shots.notes: Mira dashes across the front of the lawn while Mango zooms in a circle behind her.

shots.title: Chorus A – up and down
shots.notes: Mira hops and spins for the viewer while Mango hops, then play-bows beside her.

shots.title: Chorus B – yes, no, copy
shots.notes: Mango nods and shakes his head, Mira waves and claps to invite the viewer, and the shot ends on a polite bow.

shots.title: Verse 2 – jumps (low angle)
shots.notes: Low angle from the grass: Mira jumps toward the balloons by the fence, and Mango bobs his head, then wags.

shots.title: Verse 2 – bow, balloons rise
shots.notes: Mira bows gracefully, then points up as the pink balloons float off the fence, while Mango hops excitedly.

shots.title: Chorus A – up and down
shots.notes: Mango walks across the front of the frame and spins, while Mira jumps, stretches high and bows low.

shots.title: Chorus B – yes, no, copy
shots.notes: Mira nods and shakes her head at the viewer and cheers, while Mango play-bows an invitation.

shots.title: Verse 2 again – Mango close
shots.notes: New angle: a close-up on Mango wagging his whole body while Mira hops behind him.

shots.title: Verse 2 again – orbit, balloons rise
shots.notes: A slow orbit as Mira bows, then cheers the rising balloons, while Mango sniffs the grass and spins.

shots.title: Chorus A – up and down
shots.notes: Mira walks in across the lawn, stretches high and bows low, while Mango nods along, then spins.

shots.title: Chorus B – yes, no, copy
shots.notes: Mango nods and shakes his head, while Mira waves, claps and nods encouragingly to the viewer.

shots.title: Meadow – red kite high
shots.notes: An iris opens on the bright meadow: the red kite sways high as Mira points up, then dances.

shots.title: Kite swoops, Mango sniffs
shots.notes: Ground-level close-up of Mango: he hops at the swooping kite, then sniffs the flowers.

shots.title: Chorus A – up and down
shots.notes: Mango walks across the flowers in front of Mira, who jumps and spins, and he ends in a play-bow.

shots.title: Chorus B – yes, no, copy
shots.notes: Mira nods and shakes her head, while Mango raises a paw, then hops toward the viewer as Mira cheers.

shots.title: Verse 4 – nod and shake
shots.notes: Golden-hour close-up: Mira nods yes, Mango shakes no, and Mira claps along.

shots.title: Wave hello and goodbye
shots.notes: A wide sunset meadow: Mira waves hello and goodbye to the glowing sky while Mango raises a paw.

shots.title: Chorus A – up and down
shots.notes: The balloons drift up in the sunset while Mira hops, stretches and bows and Mango spins on the glowing grass.

shots.title: Chorus B – yes, no, copy
shots.notes: Mango nods and shakes his head, and Mira waves, bows to the viewer and ends on a soft goodbye wave.

shots.title: Instrumental · dance in the sunset
shots.notes: Instrumental break: they dance together while the camera circles.

shots.title: Slow chorus – gentle sway
shots.notes: A slow orbit at sunset: Mira sways, stretches and slowly spins while Mango gently nods and play-bows.

shots.title: Slow chorus – soft goodbye
shots.notes: A slow dolly-in on gentle nods, waves and claps, settling into a calm stretch and a slow tail wag.

shots.title: Instrumental · a walk through the meadow
shots.notes: They walk side by side across the meadow (walk clips).

shots.title: Instrumental · play together
shots.notes: Playtime before the final chorus.

shots.title: Final chorus A – balloons up
shots.notes: Balloons float up as Mira jumps, and Mango walks across the front, spins, and Mira stretches, then bows.

shots.title: Final chorus B – final bow
shots.notes: Mira nods, shakes and cheers while Mango play-bows to the viewer, then Mira's final bow and a goodbye wave and paw as the balloons rise into the sunset.

shots.title: Outro · goodbye wave
shots.notes: Goodbye to the viewer while the balloons float up.

shots.title: Outro · final view (end card)
shots.notes: The camera looks up to the sunset sky under the end card.

landscape.why: A cheerful neighbourhood of colourful cottages around the backyard; trees and flowers sway in the morning breeze.
A winding river with flowing water behind the flower meadow, a few cottages beyond it, lush swaying flowers.

lines.en: Walking slowly, slow, slow, slow,
lines.cue: Wide shot of the sunny backyard garden in soft morning light. Mira walks slowly on the grass with big careful steps and a calm, focused smile, looking down at her feet. Mango sits on the grass and tilts his head, watching her curiously.
lines.text: Walking slowly, slow, slow, slow,

lines.en: Past the flowers, here we go!
lines.cue: Low child-height side shot along the flowerbeds. Mango waddles slowly past the flowers, sniffing the petals and looking proud. Mira stands still, giggles and claps softly, looking down at him.
lines.text: Past the flowers, here we go!

lines.en: Now we're running, fast, fast, fast!
lines.cue: Camera tracks quickly beside Mira as she runs fast across the lawn, excited and laughing, eyes forward. Mango stays put, wagging his tail wildly and twitching his ears as he watches her zoom.
lines.text: Now we're running, fast, fast, fast!

lines.en: Round the garden, zooming past!
lines.cue: Wide overhead shot. Mango runs fast in a big circle around the garden with his ears flapping, joyful and looking ahead. Mira stands in the middle and cheers with both arms up, turning her head to follow him.
lines.text: Round the garden, zooming past!

lines.en: Slow and fast, and up and down,
lines.cue: Medium shot facing camera in the backyard. Mira steps slowly, then quickly, smiling at the viewer. Mango does excited hops up and down beside her, looking up at Mira.
lines.text: Slow and fast, and up and down,

lines.en: High and low, now spin around!
lines.cue: Mira spins happily with her arms out, looking up at the sky. Mango play-bows low beside her, tail wagging, watching her twirl.
lines.text: High and low, now spin around!

lines.en: Yes and no, hello, goodbye,
lines.cue: Close-up of Mango nodding, then shaking his head so his ears flop, with a cheeky grin. Mira waves at the camera with a bright, friendly face.
lines.text: Yes and no, hello, goodbye,

lines.en: Come on, copy, give it a try!
lines.cue: Medium shot. Mira claps and smiles straight at the viewer, inviting them to join. Mango raises a paw toward the camera and tilts his head, eager and sweet.
lines.text: Come on, copy, give it a try!

lines.en: Mira jumps up, up, up, up!
lines.cue: Low-angle shot from the grass. Mira jumps up again and again, delighted, looking up toward the bunch of pink balloons tied to the garden fence. Mango sits and watches, his head bobbing up and down as he follows her.
lines.text: Mira jumps up, up, up, up!

lines.en: Mango wags, a happy pup!
lines.cue: Close-up of Mango wagging his tail so hard his whole chubby body wiggles, eyes sparkling as he looks up at Mira. Mira stops jumping and laughs, hands on her cheeks.
lines.text: Mango wags, a happy pup!

lines.en: Now bow down, down to the ground,
lines.cue: Medium side shot. Mira bows down slowly and gracefully, calm and proud, looking at the grass. Mango sits up tall and tilts his head, puzzled and curious.
lines.text: Now bow down, down to the ground,

lines.en: Up float balloons, pink and round!
lines.cue: Camera tilts up from the fence. A gentle breeze lifts the pink balloons high on their long ribbons. Mira looks up and points, full of wonder. Mango does excited hops beneath them, ears bouncing.
lines.text: Up float balloons, pink and round!

lines.en: Slow and fast, and up and down,
lines.cue: Wide backyard shot with the pink balloons bobbing on the fence. Mira jumps up and down, joyful, looking at the camera. Mango walks slowly, then trots fast in front of her, tongue out.
lines.text: Slow and fast, and up and down,

lines.en: High and low, now spin around!
lines.cue: Mango spins in a happy circle chasing his tail, giggly-eyed. Mira stretches up high, then bows low, smiling down at him.
lines.text: High and low, now spin around!

lines.en: Yes and no, hello, goodbye,
lines.cue: Close-up of Mira nodding yes, then shaking her head no, with a playful grin at the viewer. Mango twitches his ears and wags his tail, looking up at her.
lines.text: Yes and no, hello, goodbye,

lines.en: Come on, copy, give it a try!
lines.cue: Medium shot facing camera. Mango play-bows toward the viewer, inviting them to play. Mira cheers with both arms raised, eyes on the camera.
lines.text: Come on, copy, give it a try!

lines.en: Mira jumps up, up, up, up!
lines.cue: Low-angle shot from the grass. Mira jumps up again and again, delighted, looking up toward the bunch of pink balloons tied to the garden fence. Mango sits and watches, his head bobbing up and down as he follows her.
lines.text: Mira jumps up, up, up, up!

lines.en: Mango wags, a happy pup!
lines.cue: Close-up of Mango wagging his tail so hard his whole chubby body wiggles, eyes sparkling as he looks up at Mira. Mira stops jumping and laughs, hands on her cheeks.
lines.text: Mango wags, a happy pup!

lines.en: Now bow down, down to the ground,
lines.cue: Medium side shot. Mira bows down slowly and gracefully, calm and proud, looking at the grass. Mango sits up tall and tilts his head, puzzled and curious.
lines.text: Now bow down, down to the ground,

lines.en: Up float balloons, pink and round!
lines.cue: Camera tilts up from the fence. A gentle breeze lifts the pink balloons high on their long ribbons. Mira looks up and points, full of wonder. Mango does excited hops beneath them, ears bouncing.
lines.text: Up float balloons, pink and round!

lines.en: Slow and fast, and up and down,
lines.cue: Wide meadow shot with the red kite high in the sky. Mira walks slowly, then runs fast through the flowers, laughing. Mango sits and nods along, watching her go.
lines.text: Slow and fast, and up and down,

lines.en: High and low, now spin around!
lines.cue: Mira stretches high toward the kite, then bows low to the flowers, smiling. Mango spins in a quick circle beside her, ears flying.
lines.text: High and low, now spin around!

lines.en: Yes and no, hello, goodbye,
lines.cue: Medium shot. Mango nods yes, then shakes his head no, looking at the viewer with a silly face. Mira waves hello, then goodbye to the camera, bright-eyed.
lines.text: Yes and no, hello, goodbye,

lines.en: Come on, copy, give it a try!
lines.cue: Close-up of Mira clapping and nodding at the viewer, encouraging and warm. Mango raises a paw beside her and wags his tail.
lines.text: Come on, copy, give it a try!

lines.en: Red kite flying high, so high,
lines.cue: Wide establishing shot of the flowery meadow under a bright blue sky. The big red kite soars high. Mira holds the string, looks up and points, amazed. Mango tilts his head way back, ears twitching, staring at the kite.
lines.text: Red kite flying high, so high,

lines.en: Dancing in the big blue sky!
lines.cue: Low-angle shot through the flowers. Mira dances happily with the kite string in hand, looking up at the kite. Mango wags his tail and stays still, watching the kite sway.
lines.text: Dancing in the big blue sky!

lines.en: Swooping low, low, low it goes,
lines.cue: Camera follows the red kite swooping low over the flowers. Mira gently pulls the string, focused and smiling. Mango does excited hops toward the kite, surprised and gleeful.
lines.text: Swooping low, low, low it goes,

lines.en: Mango sniffs low with his nose!
lines.cue: Ground-level close-up of Mango sniffing low among the meadow flowers, nose twitching, curious. Mira laughs and claps behind him, looking down fondly.
lines.text: Mango sniffs low with his nose!

lines.en: Slow and fast, and up and down,
lines.cue: Golden meadow at sunset. Mango walks slowly, then trots fast through the flowers, happy. Mira jumps up and down, watching him and laughing.
lines.text: Slow and fast, and up and down,

lines.en: High and low, now spin around!
lines.cue: Mira spins with her arms wide in the warm light, joyful, eyes on the sky. Mango play-bows low, then twitches his ears, watching her.
lines.text: High and low, now spin around!

lines.en: Yes and no, hello, goodbye,
lines.cue: Medium two-shot. Mira nods yes, then shakes her head no, smiling at the viewer. Mango raises a paw hello, then lowers it goodbye, gentle and sweet.
lines.text: Yes and no, hello, goodbye,

lines.en: Come on, copy, give it a try!
lines.cue: Close-up of Mango doing excited hops toward the camera, ears bouncing. Mira cheers behind him, looking straight at the viewer.
lines.text: Come on, copy, give it a try!

lines.en: Yes, yes, yes, we nod our heads,
lines.cue: Golden-hour medium shot in the meadow, with the red kite resting in the grass. Mira nods yes with a big happy smile at the camera. Mango wags his tail and looks up at her, content.
lines.text: Yes, yes, yes, we nod our heads,

lines.en: No, no, no, we shake instead!
lines.cue: Close-up of Mango shaking his head no, floppy ears swinging, with a playful face. Mira giggles and covers her mouth, looking down at him.
lines.text: No, no, no, we shake instead!

lines.en: Wave hello, the day was fun,
lines.cue: Warm side shot. Mira twirls the bunch of pink balloons, smiling and looking at the camera. Mango raises a paw in a friendly hello, proud and sweet.
lines.text: Wave hello, the day was fun,

lines.en: Wave goodbye to the setting sun!
lines.cue: Wide sunset shot of the meadow glowing orange and pink. Mira waves goodbye to the sinking sun, calm and happy. Mango sits beside her and tilts his head toward the sun, slowly wagging his tail.
lines.text: Wave goodbye to the setting sun!

lines.en: Slow and fast, and up and down,
lines.cue: Wide sunset shot. The pink balloons float up high on their ribbons in Mira's hand. Mira steps slowly, then quickly, grinning. Mango hops up and down, looking at the balloons.
lines.text: Slow and fast, and up and down,

lines.en: High and low, now spin around!
lines.cue: Mango spins in a happy circle on the glowing grass. Mira stretches high, then bows low, giggling at him.
lines.text: High and low, now spin around!

lines.en: Yes and no, hello, goodbye,
lines.cue: Close-up of Mango nodding, then shaking his head, sleepy but happy. Mira waves goodbye toward the camera, soft and warm.
lines.text: Yes and no, hello, goodbye,

lines.en: Come on, copy, give it a try!
lines.cue: Final wide shot as the camera slowly pulls back over the sunset meadow. Mira bows to the viewer with a proud smile. Mango wags his tail and raises a paw. The pink balloons sway above them.
lines.text: Come on, copy, give it a try!

director.message:
Project 05 "Mira and Mango: Up and Down!" — animation direction for the FINAL SONG "Slow and Fast" (Suno, 3:32.4). Line times are measured from the real vocals.

CAST & SCALE: Mira (card 50, two-legged rig with walk/run clips) is a 5-year-old girl: scale 0.75 (about 1.1 m). Mango (card 51, four-legged rig with walk/run clips) is her chubby puppy: scale 0.38 (about 0.55 m). Props: Big Red Kite (card 54, a sky object: y 3.5–4.5) and Pink Balloon Bunch (card 55, scale 1.4). Places: Sunny Backyard Garden (card 52, setting_scale 0.75) for line indices 0–23; Sunny Meadow 3 (card 53, setting_scale 1.2) for indices 24–47. Use only these six assets.

GOLDEN RULES
- Use EXACTLY the shots listed below (same line ranges), so each shot is about 5 s. Fit every action inside the shot's length.
- Mira sings; Mango reacts. Never the same move at the same moment (stagger by at least 0.5 s). Each character gets 2–3 actions per shot with its own timing; they look at / turn to each other when not facing the viewer.
- Keep them at least 1.2 m apart; paths never cross each other or the props. Walk/run across the frame or toward the camera, never away. Feet on the ground (y 0); only the kite and the balloons go up.
- Face the camera (rot_y 0) when singing to the viewer.
- Cameras: never closeup or follow a sky object (the kite or balloons). Open each place wide, then full and medium shots, close-ups for key words (Mango's close-ups on his lines). Never the same size three times in a row. The SECOND "Verse 2" (indices 16–19) uses different camera angles and actions from the first one (indices 8–11). Repeat the chorus camera pattern in every normal chorus; the slow chorus (indices 40–43) uses slow orbits and dolly-ins and gentle actions (sway, nod, stretch).
- Lighting: garden = morning (indices 0–23), meadow = day (24–31), meadow = sunset (32–47).
- Transitions: dissolve into every chorus, iris at the place change (index 24), cut otherwise.
- Long instrumental parts are added later as separate shots; just end each shot with a pleasant pose.

STAGING NOTES: verse 1 = slow walk then fast run around the garden lawn; verse 2 = Mira jumps / bows, Mango wags, balloons float up by the fence; verse 3 = red kite high then swooping low, Mango sniffs the flowers; verse 4 = nod yes, shake no, wave hello and goodbye to the setting sun; final chorus = balloons float up, final bow.
last.reply: I kept your 24 shots exactly. The backyard garden runs in morning light for shots 1–12. The meadow opens with an iris at shot 13, in day light up to shot 16 and sunset from shot 17. Every normal chorus repeats one camera pair: a full group shot for 'Slow and fast', then a medium dolly-in for 'Yes and no'. The slow chorus uses an orbit and then a dolly-in with gentle sway, nod and stretch. Mira sings facing the viewer, Mango reacts with staggered four-legged moves, and each long shot ends on a calm, pleasant pose so the instrumental shots can be added later.
did: Cast and scale as requested: Mira 0.75, Mango 0.38, balloons 1.4, kite in the sky at y 3.5–4.5. Garden setting_scale 0.75 (shots 1–12), meadow setting_scale 1.2 (shots 13–24).
Verse 1: Mira walks slowly across the lawn, Mango sniffs, then moves past the flowerbeds. Mira runs across the front of the frame while Mango circles behind her.
Verse 2: first time is a low-angle tilt-up (jump, bow, lookUp; balloons rise). Second time is a Mango close-up plus a wide orbit, with different moves (hop, cheer, sniff, spin).
Verse 3: wide tilt-up on the kite. The kite swoops from y 4.5 down to 3.5 while the camera holds a ground-level close-up of Mango sniffing.
Verse 4: close-up of Mira nodding while Mango shakes his head, then a wide sunset shot of waving hello and goodbye.
Final chorus: balloons rise and Mira gives a final bow.
Transitions: dissolve into every chorus (shots 3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 21, 23), iris at shot 13, cuts everywhere else.
Lighting: morning for shots 1–12, day for 13–16, sunset for 17–24.
Spacing: the characters always stay at least 1.2 m apart. Travel goes across the frame, and props sit clear of every path.
Camera sizes never repeat three times in a row. The kite is never the target of a close-up or follow.
cannot: Facial expressions (smiles, giggles, grins, sleepy eyes) and gestures like hands on cheeks or covering the mouth: the engine only does automatic blinks and singing mouths.
Mira cannot hold the kite string or the balloon ribbons, because there is no hand attachment. The balloons stand beside her instead, and the kite flies on its own.
Lyric cues for lines 20–23 mention the meadow and the red kite. Your note puts lines 0–23 in the garden, so those shots stay in the garden without the kite.
Run speed cannot be chosen; the rig walks or runs at its natural pace. 'Slow then fast' is suggested by the timing of actions and travel.
There is no overhead camera for line 3, so the Mango circle is covered by Mira's follow shot.
Line 39's 'camera pulls back' becomes the repeated chorus dolly-in, to keep the chorus pattern your note asks for.
Characters cannot turn their heads toward props (the kite or balloons). The look/turn controls only target other characters.
There is no sun asset to wave at for line 35. Mira waves toward the sunset sky.
The 'kite resting in the grass' cue for line 32 is not possible, because the kite is a sky object.
